_README: Billed executions that left NO usage record, so neither the passes register nor the superseded-executions ledger (D22) can price them from a meta (PI ruling D35, 2026-10-05). Each entry names its derivation: 'invoice' (an invoice line isolates it), 'transcript-reconstruction' (usage rebuilt from figures a session transcript kept; D35 admits these for this ledger only, never a register row), 'comparable-leg' (a same-configuration leg's measured tokens, scaled), 'note-estimate' (a figure from the project's notes), or 'exposure-bound' (a ceiling on spend that may be zero; estimate_usd null). estimate_usd is the best figure, at the higher candidate tier where the tier is unknown (the register's never-understate rule); bounds_usd brackets it. WP6's project total adds estimated_total_usd and reports exposure_total_usd separately. A register pass that lost spend this way is audited-lower-bound (register_effect). Built in the S160 register repair from reports/launch-archaeology-2026-10-04.md section 4 and its follow-up; append as more are found, never delete an entry.
